settings.title: Settings
settings.fqdn_help: Changing this hostname also requires updating the server URL in existing BBS agents.
settings.tls_help: When disabled, NethServer uses its default certificate. BBS agents must trust that certificate; use a trusted certificate for unattended clients.
settings.ssh_port_help: Port on which Borg Backup Server listens for client connections.
settings.invalid_fqdn: Enter a valid fully qualified domain name, such as bbs.example.com.
settings.invalid_ssh_port: Enter an unused TCP port from 1024 to 65535.
settings.port_in_use: This TCP port is already in use on the node. Choose another port.
settings.admin_password_notice: Set a password here only during initial configuration. NethServer does not store it after BBS initializes.
settings.admin_password_help: Optional. Set this only before BBS is initialized. Leave blank to let BBS generate a password. After initialization, use Advanced options to change it.
settings.admin_password_reset_notice: These options let you change the standard BBS admin account password and optionally remove local TOTP 2FA.
settings.admin_password_reset_2fa_help: To remove local 2FA from the admin account, you must also enter a new password.
settings.invalid_reset_admin_password: Use 8–72 UTF-8 bytes on one line, without NUL characters.
settings.password_required_for_2fa_reset: Enter and confirm a new password to remove 2FA.
settings.confirm_admin_password_reset: The password for the standard BBS admin account will be replaced, and the Borg Backup Server service will restart. Running backup operations may be interrupted. Continue?
settings.confirm_admin_password_reset_2fa: The password for the standard BBS admin account will be replaced, its local TOTP setup and recovery codes will be removed, and the Borg Backup Server service will restart. Running backup operations may be interrupted. MFA managed by an external OIDC provider is not affected. Continue?
settings.admin_password_reset_success: The password for the standard BBS admin account was reset, and the Borg Backup Server service was restarted.
settings.admin_password_reset_success_2fa: The standard BBS admin password was reset, its TOTP setup and recovery codes were removed, and the Borg Backup Server service was restarted.
settings.admin_password_already_initialized: BBS is already initialized. Change the administrator password from the BBS web interface.
